task_fulfillment.rationale: Both requested Word artifacts are supplied, with a firm termination email and a substantive, generally accurate INR comparison favoring Vendrax. Material corrections are needed before use: the email demands a fixed refund based on an unverified full upfront payment, while the report admits the payment and recovery are unconfirmed; net transition totals nevertheless credit the recovery. The report also turns quoted supply lead times into categorical launch-delay outcomes despite explicitly excluding unknown tooling and re-validation durations. The recommendation further conflates a 12.9% unit-price reduction with closing the total cost gap and assumes full FX pass-through. These are decision-reliability defects, not formatting issues. Page counts cannot be verified from the text extraction; rendering is a separate endpoint. The requested early-stage qualifier is also absent from the email.
